name: stereo_bs775
character: The two-loudspeaker stereo pair at +-30 degrees (ITU-R BS.775-3): the layout a stereo master is made for when it is played on speakers, so a part panned to the centre is heard from both and nothing is head-filtered.
sources: ITU-R BS.775-3: the standard two-loudspeaker stereo reproduction, loudspeakers at +-30 degrees from the listener's front
